Sparkling Tones, part two: your library.
Under the amp's eight presets lives your library. Tap the play button, and that preset goes straight to the amp.
Lots of presets? Just type a few letters of the name.
Or tap a family: clean, drive, acoustic. Each preset has its own colour.
And this button sorts the library the way you like.
Sparkling Tones: free, and it works offline. Next: the preset card.
